## Yukti One Minute Game – 2024

21 Mar 2024 - 21 Mar 2024 |Organized by:Information Technology
Guess the movie : challenges your deduction skills , cinema knowledge, you’ll decipher the names and theme of films represented by pictures .Name dropping : We will say a domain name, and players should write what comes in that domain in one minute. For example, if the domain is “shoes,” players should write brands like Nike, Sketchers, Puma, etc.Toothpick Word Arrangement : Players are given a word, and they should arrange the letters of the word using toothpicks in one minute.Memory Game : Players will be shown the position of objects, and then the objects will be removed. Players should place them back in the correct position within one minute.Gems and Straw : There will be gems in a plate, and players will pick them up using a straw and place them in another plate within one minute.Balls and Cups : Cups will be inverted, and a ball will be placed on one cup. - Guess the movie : challenges your deduction skills , cinema knowledge, you’ll decipher the names and theme of films represented by pictures .
- Name dropping : We will say a domain name, and players should write what comes in that domain in one minute. For example, if the domain is “shoes,” players should write brands like Nike, Sketchers, Puma, etc.
- Toothpick Word Arrangement : Players are given a word, and they should arrange the letters of the word using toothpicks in one minute.
- Memory Game : Players will be shown the position of objects, and then the objects will be removed. Players should place them back in the correct position within one minute.
- Gems and Straw : There will be gems in a plate, and players will pick them up using a straw and place them in another plate within one minute.
- Balls and Cups : Cups will be inverted, and a ball will be placed on one cup. Players should use cups to transfer the ball from one cup to another. This should be repeated for three cups, and then the player should place them in another plate within one minute.

## Venue:

D-307, D Block, MGIT

## Event Guidelines:

- Each game lasts for exactly one minute.
- Participants must follow instructions and complete tasks within the allotted time.
- The participant with the highest score or fastest completion time wins each game.
- The last date for registration is on or before 21 march 2024, 9:00 AM.
